free.intro: Session mode automates a consumer account — real risks, stated plainly:
free.risk1: Your GOOGLE ACCOUNT may be banned (losing Gmail/Drive/YouTube if it's your main account).
free.risk2: No guarantee/no SLA: the session can expire or be blocked at any point mid-run.
free.risk3: Unstable: quality/format depend on the consumer UI and break when Google updates it.
free.risk4: The risk cannot be removed — delay only reduces it.
free.mitigTitle: Mitigations (if you accept the risk, to ease the pain):
free.mitig1: Use a secondary account, never one holding important data.
free.mitig2: Set a large enough delay and a modest daily volume.
free.mitig3: Prefer the official API for important/high-volume work.
free.mitig4: Back up results early; don't rely on free sessions for tight deadlines.
free.note: This tool only implements the warning + the delay you configure, NOT any detection-evasion.
